draft.text: You came because you have been having sudden visual distortions and blurring of vision.
Straight lines look crooked, and it is hard for you to adjust to dim lights, like in restaurants.
We did not find any results from tests or exams during this visit.
You are having trouble with your vision, especially in dim lighting.
This is a concerning symptom, and the cause is not clear yet.
You will be referred for further evaluation to find out why you are having these vision changes.
You will also be advised to stop smoking and manage your blood pressure.
A follow-up appointment will be scheduled to check on your symptoms and give more guidance.
